titles: Checking for roaches and their eggs
From egg to adult, inside the case
editorial_check: Every paragraph supplies mechanism, recognition, inspection or monitoring detail. No repeated no-hatch conclusion or generic useful-takeaway ending. Options are intentionally shorter than the previous padded batch.
limits: Under-sink inspection is an application of warm, moist habitat plus extension inspection sites, not a wasp-sighting diagnosis.
Option 3 compares egg handling; it does not identify German cockroaches as this wasp's hosts.
Option 5 teaches natural-enemy biology and makes no whole-home treatment claim.
